FX-SMOOTH-001.says: One step between white and black, softness 50: row 4 turns into an even slope across the whole row, and no other row changes.

FX-SMOOTH-002.says: The same at softness 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SMOOTH-003.says: The same at softness 100: the slope falls half as fast, so it is still part of the way down at both ends of the row; row 4 only.

FX-SMOOTH-004.says: A one-pixel black line stepping down every three pixels: each step is softened, and a pixel two rows from the line is untouched.

FX-SMOOTH-005.says: A black box six by four: straight edges and corners of 4 or more, so nothing changes.

FX-SMOOTH-006.says: A black box three by three: its corners are shorter than 4 and are rounded.

FX-SMOOTH-007.says: A red line on blue: every pixel is red, blue or a mix of the two, never darker.

FX-SMOOTH-008.says: A black line on nothing: the softened pixels are black, partly covering, with no grey or white fringe.

FX-SMOOTH-009.says: A red line on nothing: every pixel that shows is the line's red.

FX-SMOOTH-010.says: Two skin colours six apart, threshold 10: one colour to the rule, so nothing changes.

FX-SMOOTH-011.says: The same at threshold 0: two colours, and their step is softened.

FX-SMOOTH-012.says: Softness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-SMOOTH-002, frame 2 is FX-SMOOTH-001, frame 4 is FX-SMOOTH-003.

FX-SMOOTH-013.says: FX-SMOOTH-001 moved two pixels right: the same smoothed drawing, moved; the smoothing is done on the drawing's own pixels before it is moved.

FX-SMOOTH-020.says: Softness 150, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMOOTH-021.says: Threshold -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SMOOTH-022.says: Softness keyed to 120 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
